summary.value: Hilton Club New York is a Hilton Grand Vacations club offering stylish Studios and spacious Suites with skyline views, located in the heart of Midtown Manhattan. It suits travelers who want apartment-like space close to Fifth Avenue shopping, Rockefeller Center and Broadway, and it is well regarded by Tripadvisor guests at 4.3 of 5 bubbles (940 reviews). Saved reviews do not list specific complaints, so check fees and unit type when booking.
